excerpt: Benefit from the experience of top data journalists from leading outlets and schools, including the New York Times, Zeit Online and the W. Cronkite J-School. Master the essentials Learn to produce data stories quickly and effectively. Discover how to transform data into simple, compelling and informative visualisations. Get a global perspective Find out how journalists from Europe, Latin America, North America and Africa have overcome challenges when obtaining and working with data. Boost job market value Future-proof your career by gaining the highly demanded data analysis and presentation skills that are necessary for many data journalism jobs today. Dates Start: May 19th Ends: December 31st 2014 Language English Subtitles: EN, FR, ES Requirements Basic journalism skills. Basic Computer Literacy. Familiarity with spreadsheets.
